# powl_choice_graph_edge

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

One directed edge of a ChoiceGraphNode.edges set over ChoiceGraphEndpoint (Start | Child(usize) | End); may be cyclic (a self-loop Child(i)->Child(i) is a POWL 1.0-style loop over a single child, generalized).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from_kind` | `atom` | yes | The edge source endpoint kind: start | child | end (ChoiceGraphEndpoint variant tag; start has no incoming edges, end has no outgoing edges per Def. 3.6). |
| `from_child_index` | `integer` | no | Index into the parent ChoiceGraphNode's children when from_kind is child; absent otherwise. |
| `to_kind` | `atom` | yes | The edge target endpoint kind: start | child | end. |
| `to_child_index` | `integer` | no | Index into the parent ChoiceGraphNode's children when to_kind is child; absent otherwise. |
